_comment: Plans 08a/08b (D7, D19, D20, D28): pinned Piper voice files for fetch_voices.py. Nothing downloaded is committed. The patched model adds the /Ceil_output_0 alignment output (onnx 1.23.2); its SHA-256 is enforced. "public": false = private test releases only (D28); the public release leaves such packs out. D28 changed 2026-11-16 (owner): pierre is public; its base model (lessac) was trained on research-only data, so "risk_note" is written to its SOURCE.txt and the voice may be withdrawn ("public": false again + a new release). pierre's "inference" = owner blind-sheet winner V4 (2026-11-14, voice-evaluation.md 9c); siwis' "inference" = its own scales with length_scale 1.1 (owner 2026-11-14: a little too fast); "inference_word" = lower noise for isolated words (noise_scale, noise_w; length_scale stays), owner 2026-11-14; since 0.7.2 only the fallback of pierre's "word_carrier" (an isolated word is said inside « Le mot : {0}. » and cut out: owner blind sheet W5, voice-evaluation.md 9d); "phoneme_fix" = phoneme post-corrections of the voice (pierre: iʲ -> i, « il y a », 9d); siwis has the same "word_carrier" since 2026-11-16 (owner blind sheet, voice-evaluation.md 9e: 4.67 / 4.72 against 3.72 alone), its fallback is the word alone with the voice scales, and "word_carrier_except" lists words always said alone ("eu", "les": better alone on that sheet; compared trimmed, lower case).

pierre.risk_note: Base model: fine-tuned from the Piper voice lessac, whose training data is licensed for research only. The owner accepts the risk (D28, 2026-11-16): if that licence is challenged, this voice is withdrawn from the public release.

Données : UPMC Pierre Voice Data — « A French speech corpus designed for synthesis, recorded in 2013 at the Institut des Systèmes Intelligents et de Robotique (ISIR), Université Pierre et Marie Curie (UPMC) by Pierre Chauvin, a male native speaker of French. » (github.com/marytts/upmc-pierre-data, révision 93d6429b), licence CC BY-SA 4.0.
Affiné à partir de la voix anglaise lessac (corpus Blizzard 2013, usage de recherche) ; cette voix pourra être retirée si la licence de ce modèle de base est contestée.
